verdict.rationale: Cognee is open-source and can be fully self-hosted (Docker, local UI, no account required), giving users complete control over where their data physically resides — a strong proxy for data residency. However, there is no documented region-selection feature within Cognee Cloud itself (e.g., choosing EU vs US data centers), so residency is achieved only via self-hosting, not via a first-class regional-storage option. Missing for 10: explicit multi-region cloud storage/selection controls, documented data-residency/compliance certifications (e.g., GDPR region pinning) for the hosted offering.
